278080256.description:
Natural Specimen
Polished Blue Agate Geode
Natural Agate and Druzy Quartz
Approx. 5.5" H x 4" W x 2" D
Unsigned
This striking geological specimen features a vibrant, deep blue agate body with a brilliant white druzy quartz crystalline center. The face and sides have been professionally polished to a high-gloss finish, revealing the intricate banding and depth of the stone, while the back remains in its raw, natural state. The rich teal-blue hue highlights the natural crystalline structures within the central cavity, creating a dramatic decorative piece suitable for modern or naturalist interiors.
Features a prominent central druzy cavity with sparkling translucent quartz crystals
Substantial weight of 2.4 lbs makes it ideal for use as a single bookend or paperweight
Flat-sawn base and sides allow for stable upright display on shelves or mantels
Polished surface showcases fine concentric banding typical of high-quality agate
Condition:
Very good condition with a high-luster polish on the primary surfaces. As a natural geological item, it contains inherent pits, fissures, and variations in texture and color that are characteristic of the medium. The base shows minor shelf wear consistent with display, but the polished faces remain smooth and vibrant.
